subject: DST bridgebackfill — propose fallback demo windows for CobaltAnalytics
body:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Conway <alex@cobaltanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: DST bridgebackfill — propose fallback demo windows for CobaltAnalytics

Alex / Priya —

Quick follow-up after our sync this morning. As a heads-up: US DST starts the week of Mar 14 this year, while EU switches a week later. That creates a one-week window where our usual time slots will shift across regions and could cause confusion for attendees (particularly EMEA participants).

To avoid back-and-forth in the week of the changeover, I propose a short "bridgebackfill" plan: offer two explicit fallback demo windows that will be offered in parallel to customers that fall inside that mismatch week. This lets folks pick the window that matches their local clock without us re-issuing invites multiple times.

Proposed fallback windows (all local times):
- EMEA-friendly: 14:00-15:00 CET (covers London/Paris/Berlin local times)
- Americas-friendly: 10:00-11:00 PT / 13:00-14:00 ET
- APAC alternate (onsite recording + live Q&A): 16:00-17:00 SGT

Operational notes:
- We will send a single calendar placeholder with three session options and a clear timezone label; when a customer selects, we will update the event.
- Record the APAC session and schedule a 30-minute follow-up office-hours slot that works for EMEA.
- Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (MAP) attached; demo-slide-deck.pptx attached.

Can you confirm whether the EMEA contact (Priya) can make the 14:00 CET option? If not, propose an alternate in the 15:00-16:00 CET band and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

---

From: Alex Conway <alex@cobaltanalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 10:01:12 -0400
Subject: Re: DST bridgebackfill — propose fallback demo windows for CobaltAnalytics

Thanks Grace — this makes total sense. Priya (our EMEA lead) is in London and she flagged the exact same concern: we're in a bind the week when the US has already moved clocks and the EU hasn't.

Priya and I reviewed the windows you proposed. EMEA prefers the 14:00 CET window if the host's start time is clearly listed as CET (not ambiguous local). The only ask: if you decide to use a single invite, could you include a short note explaining the DST mismatch and list the three windows with explicit TZs? That prevents folks from assuming their calendar app will auto-convert correctly.

Also: can we get a 10-15 minute pre-demo run with your engineer to verify audio/video given our security proxy?

Alex
Head of Solutions
CobaltAnalytics

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Conway <alex@cobaltanalytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 14:37:45 +0000
Subject: Re: DST bridgebackfill — propose fallback demo windows for CobaltAnalytics

Great points, Alex. Quick operational reply and a concrete plan: 

1) Invite format: we will send one placeholder invite titled: "Redwood Inference — Demo (select preferred session) — CobaltAnalytics" and in the description list each session with an explicit timezone tag (e.g., "EMEA session — 14:00-15:00 CET (UTC+1)"). We'll also add a short note: "Week of DST mismatch: US already observed DST; please pick the session matching your preferred local clock."

2) Confirmed windows (hosted by Redwood):
   - EMEA: 14:00-15:00 CET (host: Marissa/CET time)
   - Americas: 10:00-11:00 PT / 13:00-14:00 ET (host: Grace/PT time)
   - APAC recorded: 16:00-17:00 SGT (recording + 30-min optional office hours)

3) Pre-demo tech-check: Marissa available 15 minutes before each live session; we'll add a separate calendar slot titled "Tech check — CobaltAnalytics" and invite your appointed admin.

4) HubSpot/logistics: I'll create the three time slots as custom meeting types and log them under HS:COB-4521. I'll also upload the MAP and slide deck to the record (links in the invite).

Attachments: demo-slide-deck.pptx, mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf

Let us know if the EMEA team needs a slightly later slot (15:00 CET) and we'll offer that as an alternate. Otherwise I'll publish the placeholder invite now.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference

---

From: Priya Sethi <priya.s@cobaltanalytics.com>
To: Alex Conway <alex@cobaltanalytics.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 15:40:10 +0000
Subject: Re: DST bridgebackfill — propose fallback demo windows for CobaltAnalytics

Thanks all — 14:00 CET works for me. Appreciate the explicit timezone labels in the invite. Two quick asks from our side: 

- Please include a one-page runbook in the invite description with the recommended browser list and a note about our proxy DNS exceptions (we will share the IP block).
- Could you add a 15-minute follow-up window for internal EMEA Qs (same week, asynchronous)? A recorded session + quick live follow-up works best for some of our team.

If you can include that in the MAP, we are good to lock in.

Kind regards,
Priya
Head of Product Operations — EMEA
CobaltAnalytics

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sethi <priya.s@cobaltanalytics.com>, Alex Conway <alex@cobaltanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 15:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DST bridgebackfill — propose fallback demo windows for CobaltAnalytics

Perfect — locking 14:00 CET for the EMEA live session. Action items I'll own:
- Add a one-paragraph runbook to the invite (browser list + proxy note) and flag where to paste the IP block you send.
- Publish a 30-minute EMEA follow-up office-hours slot the same week (will create as "Office hours — CobaltAnalytics (EMEA)").
- Post MAP and slides to the HubSpot record and attach to the calendar invite.

Marissa/Aditya/Karthik: I'll drop the calendar placeholders and MAP update now. Marissa, please add the tech-check slot (15 minutes prior) to the live events.

Thanks everyone — will confirm once invites are out and provide the runbook stub.

Grace
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (application/pdf), demo-slide-deck.pptx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation)
